notes.note: Reviewed the Windows compiler pipe correction: inherit mode let IPC completion race ChildProcess close, producing a false surviving-process fence after status0. Real desktop-win causal probes showed inherit cleanup failing after4s and piped/drained output settling with compiler status0 in528ms. The runner now forwards both pipe streams and preserves the shared Job and wrapper-close barriers. POSIX execution and Bun project/version checks are unchanged.
